Auditions are scheduled for October 11 and 12 for a live radio adaptation of Charles Dickens’ classic, ‘A Christmas Carol.’ The production aims to bring the beloved story to life with sound effects, multiple characters, and holiday cheer.

The audition process is casting five featured roles, including three men and two women, ages 20 and older. Additional roles may be available. No prior radio experience is necessary, according to organizers.

Auditions will be held October 11 at 2 p.m. and October 12 at 6 p.m. at TCT Off-Broadway, located at 213 East Franklin Street. Audition material will be provided on-site.

The play is scheduled for performance December 10 to 12. Organizers say the production aims to capture the spirit of Christmas and remind audiences what the season is truly about.

Correction (October 4, 2026): This article has been updated to clarify that featured actors must be 20 or older and that auditions are scheduled for October 11 and 12.
